text: The Karhu running brand was bought in 2008 by Karhu Holding B.V., a Dutch holding company majority-owned by former Reebok executives Huub Valkenburg and Jay Duke.
short: Karhu is owned by Karhu Holding B.V. (majority owners Huub Valkenburg and Jay Duke).

source.name: SGB Media: Finnish Running Brand Karhu Acquired
source.quote: Valkenburg and Duke, majority owners of the new holding company, KARHU Holding B.V.
